csv_scope_of_work: City of Palmdale seeks a qualified Consultant to provide professional civil and traffic engineering design services, as well as public outreach services for the Arnie Quinones Park Expansion Project. The proposed improvements include design services for the development of the upper section of the park, which is currently native soil. Amenities desired include an ADA walking path around the park with workout/fitness nooks along the path. Also included are a shaded picnic area, a dog park, trees, planter boxes, and a restroom facility. The deliverables shall include a drainage study and improvement plan. Public outreach to the local HOA and community will be required.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
